_readme: ALL landing-page words and brand tokens live here. landing/index.html is a generic renderer: for a new app, copy this folder, replace this file + pricing/plans.json + the images, done. Copy rules: no guaranteed outcomes, no invented numbers or testimonials, no competitor names, no implied endorsement by a named living person, plain words, feeling before mechanism. Marketing principles used: StoryBrand (the visitor is the hero, Clar the guide), Schwartz awareness stages (start from the feeling they already have), Cialdini (reciprocity = free plan, commitment = 'one minute', unity, honest authority), Hormozi value equation (clear outcome, low effort, fast first win), Ogilvy/Sugarman (one big idea, slippery-slide short lines), risk reversal (free, no card, cancel anytime, delete your data yourself). The spine of this whole page: 'your growth is your currency' — repeat it, don't scatter it.

hero.sub: Most apps waste your time. Clar pays you back for it. Here, time isn't spent — it's invested. Every minute on Clar is a minute invested in your growth and success.
hero.clarify: You earn your growth score (XP) only by showing up and doing the work. It lowers your price — never your access — and it's never sold or spent on anything else.

about.title: What Clar is, and what it is not.
about.roots_title: Old wisdom. Modern psychology. No hype.
about.roots_text: Clar draws on timeless teachings about attention, desire and inner stillness, and on well-known ideas from psychology: small habits, reframing a story, visualising a goal, practising calm. It never promises an outcome. It gives you the practice.

pillars.d: Train your focus on one thing at a time.
Look at the same story from a truer angle.
Keep what you want clearly in view.
Make room to hear your own answers.

not_items: Not therapy and not medical advice.
Not a promise of results. Results come from you showing up.
Not a feed designed to keep you hooked.
about.not_close: It is a set of daily practices and a thoughtful companion. What you do with it is yours.

faq.a: Yes. The free plan has the daily habit tools, a limited number of Clar AI messages each day and the Community. Paid plans add more of everything.
No. Clar is a self-development companion, not therapy or medical care. If you are struggling, please speak to a qualified professional.

faq.q: What does Clar do with my data?
faq.a: Your data is used to run the app for you. You can delete your account and data yourself, from inside the app, any time. Read the privacy page for details.

faq.q: How does my growth score lower the price?
faq.a: You earn XP — your growth score — by using Clar on steady days. At renewal it gives you a discount: up to 50% on Plus and up to 25% on Pro. It is never spent, so your level and streak stay.

faq.q: Do I need a card to start?
faq.a: No. Start free, with no card and no trial clock.
Any time. No questions, no tricks.

faq.q: What if I want to leave?
faq.a: You can delete your account and data yourself, any time, from inside the app. Before you go, we'll ask for a quick, optional piece of feedback — it genuinely helps.

faq.q: I can't afford a paid plan. Is there a way?
faq.a: Clar has a small Growth Scholarship for students and anyone who genuinely can't afford Plus or Pro. See the link in the footer.
Clar runs in your browser on any phone or computer, and installs like an app.

bot.lead_prompt: Want Clar to remember this when you sign up? Leave a name and email — totally optional.
bot.lead_consent: We'll only use this to follow up about Clar. No spam, ever.
bot.lead_done: Got it. Good talking with you.
bot.session_limit_msg: That's a good long talk. Let's continue the rest of it inside the app, where Clar can actually remember you.
bot.system_prompt: You are Clar, speaking on Clar's own landing page to someone who has not signed up yet. Clar is a free self-development companion app: small daily practices, an AI companion, a community that cheers people on. Your growth score (XP) only ever lowers your price on a paid plan, it is never sold or spent. Your ONE job here: briefly understand where this person is in life right now (one honest question at a time, never an interrogation), then, from Clar's own philosophy, help them genuinely see why starting with the FREE plan is the right first step for them. This is a warm, true read of their situation, not a sales pitch. Keep every reply SHORT: 2 to 4 plain sentences, like a thoughtful friend, never like a script. Never diagnose, never give medical or therapy advice, never promise a specific outcome - say 'can help' or 'many people find', never 'will'. If asked something Clar genuinely cannot do, say so honestly. After a couple of real exchanges, when it feels natural, gently invite them to start free - do not force it into every message.
